Unit::Taunt: Idle's body with activity 5; same gap (rand(1,3) per step and the taunt animation not reproduced)

Ship::Idle: duration should be the class idle animation's length (anim 12, record+0x4c), engine waits kDefaultIdleSlice; [ship+0x1cc] gate and the ship's activity dispatch not read; no held branch in the original
Unit::ForceIdle: [unit+0x1b8]=1; its only reader is the unmodelled idle animation activity (0x005d2ca0), so nothing is stored

Unit::GotoEnter: step-out, target drop (0x005d6810, fixed) and give-up match; gaps: answer-after-wait protocol (shared Goto design), destination clamp to the map rect, invalid-receiver answer true, taunt flag and animation remainder not reproduced
Unit::GotoAttack -> 0x005d40c0: combat target not set at entry, held/concealed targets not refused, invalid receiver/target answers, answer-after-wait (shared Goto design), 999/920 range caps
Hero::FormKeepMoving: suspension matches; formation object approximated (UpdateMove -> place_army), resume-time arrival drop (0x00417c10 -> 0x005d3830) left to movement
Unit::FormKeepMoving: target drop and suspension match; resume's arrival-test route drop not reproduced (formation-aimed route approximated)
Hero::FormSetupAndMoveTo(point): SetDest/hand-out read; a failed SetDest now ends members' form_move (0x005f2c10, fixed); range <=999 clamp absent; formation path approximated by the hero's route

Hero::FormSetupAndMoveTo(Obj): a target naming nothing changes nothing (fixed); failed SetDest as the point form; non-unit targets route centre-to-centre with [formR+tR, formR+tR+range] ignoring min (0x0052e9a0..), engine measures edge gap; clamps absent; formation approximated
Hero::FormPathLeft: formation path approximated by the hero's route; +32000 for a flagged (incomplete) path (0x004185a0) not reproduced
Unit::FormAcceptMove: no hero / no march returns 2 and ends the script (0x005d7a1c, fixed); step-out and target drop match; formation-aimed route approximated by place_army/march_member
Obj::AddCommand/void: 0x005aef20 lookup by name and shape (miss queues nothing, draws no id), insert vtbl+0xbc (accept 0x005b1760, index 1 / back); no dead test
Obj::AddCommand/point: as the void form with kind 1
Obj::AddCommand/Obj: as the void form with kind 2; the object handle is passed on unchecked
ObjList::AddCommand/void: list copy, dead members skipped, then Obj::AddCommand's rule per member
ObjList::AddCommand/point: as the void list form, kind 1
ObjList::AddCommand/Obj: an object argument that names nothing does nothing at all; else as the void list form, kind 2
Query::AddCommand/void: the query refreshed (vtbl+0x1c), every member, no dead test
Query::AddCommand/point: as the void query form, kind 1
Query::AddCommand/Obj: invalid object argument does nothing; else as the void query form, kind 2

Obj::SetCommand/void: tail cleared first (0x005b1120), lookup (miss: head kept), vtbl+0xbc then 0x005b07d0(0), which starts the new command inside the call through 0x005b4f20 (fixed: it started at the next command pass, and OUTPOST_BEHAVIOR.VS re-ordered a defender that had not left yet, for good; test set_command_starts_the_command_inside_the_call); own-script end not a cancel (0x0069fee0 stop flag). A verb with no compiled script is still left for the pass to retire
Obj::SetCommand/point: as the void form, kind 1; same deferred-launch gap
Obj::SetCommand/Obj: as the void form, kind 2; same deferred-launch gap
ObjList::SetCommand/void: dead members skipped; a lookup miss ends the head too (0x00561d6a); same deferred-launch gap
ObjList::SetCommand/point: as the void list form, kind 1; same deferred-launch gap
ObjList::SetCommand/Obj: invalid object argument does nothing; else as the void list form, kind 2; same deferred-launch gap
Query::SetCommand/void: refreshed query, no dead test, a miss ends the head; same deferred-launch gap
Query::SetCommand/point: as the void query form, kind 1; same deferred-launch gap
Query::SetCommand/Obj: invalid object argument does nothing; else as the void query form, kind 2; same deferred-launch gap

Obj::KillCommand: dead object refused; 0x005b07d0(0) (release for a costed row, onfinish cancelled unless the caller is the runner). Gaps: deferred launch of the next command; 0x005b07d0's no-op without a live slot-0 script (0x0069f950) -- here an unstarted head is ended
ObjList::KillCommand: dead members skipped; otherwise as Obj::KillCommand, same gaps
Query::KillCommand: refreshed query, no dead test; otherwise as Obj::KillCommand, same gaps
Obj::ClearCommands: dead object refused; vtbl+0xc0(0) = 0x005b1120, last index down to 1 through 0x005b07d0 (release first)
ObjList::ClearCommands: dead members skipped; as Obj::ClearCommands
Query::ClearCommands: refreshed query, no dead test; as Obj::ClearCommands

Obj::SneakCommand: empty queue untouched, bare-form lookup, clone (0x00599c40) + verb both front-inserted, head ended. Gap: the clone keeps the runner's id in the original (0x00599cdb); here it is issued a fresh one before the verb's
ObjList::SetCommandOffset: centre = mean position (0x004cd1b0), each live member's position + (pt - centre) clamped to the map rect, then SetCommand's point-form rule per member
ObjList::AddCommandOffset: as SetCommandOffset without the clear and without the clamp, AddCommand's point-form rule
Query::SetCommandOffset: refreshed query, no dead test, otherwise ObjList::SetCommandOffset
Query::AddCommandOffset: refreshed query, no dead test, no clamp, AddCommand's point-form rule

Obj::ExecCmd: invalid/dead receiver refused, row by name, void; issue 0x004ef3d0 modelled (commanded prologue, groupdispatch with the row ambient 0x004ef5c1..0x004ef6f2, enabled test, method by shape obj->point->none, immediate, research arm, order insert 0x005b4e90 with replace&&!train). Gaps: first actor's group-move set-up (0x004e9100/0x004e8ae0/0x004ef1c0) and an offset row's per-actor spread (0x004e81f0) not reproduced
ObjList::ExecCmd: the list to the issue with player -1 and no dead test of its own; same issue gaps as Obj::ExecCmd
Obj::CmdCount/0: [obj+0x98], the queue's length; a dead receiver leaves the answer unwritten in the original (answered here)
Obj::CmdCount/1: counts queued commands whose row name ([def+0xc]) equals the argument byte for byte; row-less commands never counted
Obj::command/0: the started command's name at [obj+0x110]; here the head's verb, and `idle` for a queue still empty before the first command pass (labelled reading)
Obj::command/1: the verb ([cmd+0x34]) at the index, "" past the end; index 0 of an empty queue answers `idle` here (same reading)
Obj::cmddelay: the head command's row execdelay ([def+0x1f8]), 0 with no row
Obj::Progress/0: dead receiver returns without stamp or suspend; head row's execdelay, no suspend when 0; bar endpoints display only
Obj::Progress/1: stamps [obj+0x128]/[obj+0x12c] and suspends for the argument, zero included; no dead test; the resume clears the bar
Unit::GetCommanded: bit 0x80000 of [unit+0x194], a per-unit flag raised by the issue prologue (0x004ef475), not a command's; invalid receiver answers false
Unit::SetCommanded: writes that bit, queue or no queue; invalid receiver does nothing
ObjList::GetCanExecCmd: a new list of the members whose vtbl+0xd8 (0x005ae380: [obj+0x9c] then the disabled list) accepts the row; no method test; unknown row gives an empty list
Obj::CmdDisable: row index by name (negative: nothing), vtbl+0xdc = 0x005b5250: the 0xd8 predicate then the append; no dead test (building override of 0xd8 per the earlier reading of 0x004de580)
GetCmdCost: row by name; a miss answers false and writes neither out argument; a hit writes costgold ([def+0x1e8]) and costfood ([def+0x1ec])
GetCmdStaminaCost: row by name, coststamina ([def+0x1f4]), 0 for a miss
